min-target.$description: dimension used by the option component for min target (MarsUI Dropmenu row height Space/11xl 36px; comfortably above the 24px a11y floor).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the option component for padding inline.

radius.$description: dimension used by the option component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_lg 12px bound on Dropmenu rows).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the option component for font size.

bg.$description: color used by the option component for rest background (MarsUI Dropmenu rows are transparent over the glass panel; only hover/selected paint).

fg.$description: color used by the option component for rest foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the option component for hover background (MarsUI hover_overlay_inverse Black/3 wash over the glass panel — not a solid surface step).

fg.$description: color used by the option component for hover foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the option component for keyboard-highlight background (MarsUI active row = same Black/3 wash plus Elevation/e1; purple is reserved for the selected tint).

fg.$description: color used by the option component for highlight foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the option component for selected background.

fg.$description: color used by the option component for selected foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the option component for disabled background.

fg.$description: color used by the option component for disabled foreground.
